highlights.zh-CN: 新增深浅色主题与跟随 Windows、窗口动画及未完成清理项目列表；优化清理结束速度，修复 Windows 磁盘清理提示，并支持关闭休眠释放空间。
highlights.en: Added light and dark themes with Windows theme sync, window animations, and unfinished cleanup details. Improved cleanup completion speed, fixed the Disk Cleanup prompt, and added optional hibernation cleanup.
